title: Level 5 (World Class) - C-9
notes:
West leads the ♦10 against 6♥. South will need a miracle to make this contract. East must have the ♥AQ doubleton for there to be a chance and South must hope to reach this ending. South's last club is ruffed by West and overruffed with dummy's ♥J as East follows. The ♥A will be the only trick for the defense.

In order to reach this position South has to ruff 4 of North's spades and diamonds in the closed hand. 4 entries to the dummy will be required. West's diamond opening lead will remove one entry. South will be able to ruff a club in dummy for a second entry, but 2 entries will be needed in spades - the finesse will be required.

South must take advantage of having the lead in the dummy and ruff a diamond at trick 2. After a successful spade finesse is taken, another diamond is ruffed. South crosses again in spades (it is not necessary to finesse again) and ruffs a spade in the closed hand. South then cashes 2 rounds of clubs and ruffs a club in the dummy. Dummy's last diamond is ruffed by South.

South has reached the desired end position and the lead of South's last club will hold the defense to a single trump trick.
